cohort_rule: Use ALL source rows; include a conductor stratum if it has at least two distinct isogeny labels, at least one within-class unordered pair and one between-class unordered pair, and at least one (conductor,rank) block containing two distinct isogeny labels. No manual exclusions, missing-row imputation, post-hoc source-band changes or class-size truncation. Abort if source digest/census or invariant identities fail.
preliminary_observations: None for this v2 endpoint. The prior 38-curve pilot p=0.005 (unconditioned) and p=0.344 (post-hoc rank-conditioned) are historical exploratory outcomes and must not be used as new confirmatory evidence.
invariant_calculation: Use full five-integer Weierstrass a-invariants; derive b2,b4,b6,b8,c4,c6,Delta,j with Python exact integers/Fraction. Independently check delta against completed-square cubic discriminant and c4^3-c6^2=1728*Delta. An independent Sage/eclib calculator remains a separate required external crosscheck.

primary.distances: Unweighted Euclidean distances on strictly dimensionless coordinates. Curves receive no physical positions.
primary.statistic: Across included conductors, equal-weight mean[(between-label mean pair distance - within-label mean pair distance) for ACSC - same for modified MCJ].
primary.null: Fisher-Yates labels shuffled strictly within each (conductor,rank) block. Keep all coordinates, block sizes, multiplicities and conductor memberships fixed. Singleton or homogeneous blocks are unchanged.

coordinate_scales: ACSC delta denominator log(10^29), log(10^30), log(10^31)
sensitivity.methods: Exactly six one-factor-at-a-time ablations plus the unmodified primary; report observed statistic and separately permuted p-value for each, using the same seeded conditional shuffle sequence. No 3x3x3 factorial search or favorable-scale selection.

blocked_requirements: External independent Sage/eclib invariant agreement; source snippet checks alone are insufficient
Independent second implementation of permutation statistic
Pinned executable analysis and exact-head PASS/FAIL receipt
Held-out new arithmetic source ranges or prospective replication
Any physical or astronomical observational endpoint
nonclaims: No new preregistered upstream test is being claimed; v2 protocol is frozen here before running v2, but not independently registered in Legacy.
No ACSC theorem, physical mapping, BSD, ECC or GLMPCT proof.
Null testing is arithmetic-only and cannot establish any causal/physical mechanism.
resource_budget: Before drawing permutations, abort without analysis or subsampling if total per-conductor unordered pairs across the frozen eligible cohort exceeds 300000. Preserve source cohort and eligibility rules; resource failures are BLOCKED and require a prospective versioned protocol change.
